title: The Gompertz Equation
body: The Gompertz equation $$P'=a \ln\left(\frac{K}{P}\right) P$$ has been used to model tumor growth in the human body. Its solution is $$P(t)=K e^{\ln\left(\frac{P_0}{K}\right) e^{\left(-a t\right)}}$$. Starting from one tumor cell, and assuming $$a=0.1$$ per day and a carrying capacity of $$10$$ million cells, how long does it take to reach $$5$$ million cells?
